name: PT Andalan Perkasa Abadi Tbk
summary: PT Andalan Perkasa Abadi Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, builds and manages properties in Indonesia. It operates through Hotels and Real Estate segments. The company's property portfolio consists of apartments and villas. It also operates hotels; leases villas; and sells plots. The company was formerly known as PT Ayana Land International and changed its name to PT Andalan Perkasa Abadi Tbk in September 2020. PT Andalan Perkasa Abadi Tbk was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Badung, Indonesia.
